preconditions.description: The input integer n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split()[0] == 'YES' if n == 1 or n == 2 or (n > 2 and all(pow(i, n-2, n) == 1 for i in range(1, n) if i != 0)) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: The first line of output is 'YES' if a valid permutation exists (which occurs when n=1, n=2, or n is prime), and 'NO' otherwise.
If the answer is YES, the output contains exactly n+1 lines (the YES line plus n integers).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split()[0] == 'YES' implies set(int(x) for x in stdout.strip().split()[1:]) == set(range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: If the answer is YES, the n subsequent lines form a permutation of integers from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split()[0] == 'YES' implies set((lambda seq: [1] + [((seq[i-1] * seq[i]) % n) for i in range(1, len(seq))])([int(x) for x in stdout.strip().split()[1:]]) == set(range(n))
postconditions.description: If the answer is YES, the prefix products of the output sequence modulo n form a permutation of 0 to n-1.
